target: Fujifilm X-M1 1.50 remote receive-catalog session operations

instruction_ranges.claim: Storage identifiers admit zero and all-ones special values or 0x10000001/2; storage-info rejects zero separately. Media readiness is signed nonnegative status for low-halfword indices, with special identifiers bypassing lookup.
Unused parameter words through the fifth must be zero, independently of declared parameter count.
Data-stage preparation retains operation and transaction, initializes empty transfer fields.
Responses retain transaction, clear parameter count and all five parameter values.
1005 precedence: unopened session, invalid storage, unavailable storage, unused parameters. Command stage prepares data even for errors; subsequent stage returns saved response.
1003 checks open session before unused parameters, clears session only on success, emits response directly.
1001 requires no session; nonzero unused words produce 0x2006, device producer is optional, subsequent stage emits saved response.
1002 precedence: unused parameters, zero session identifier, already-open session; success stores identifier and clears 20-byte response scratch plus 16-byte transfer bookkeeping.
1004 checks session before unused parameters and emits count plus little-endian storage words. Readable index1 encodes storage ID0x10000001.
Installed receive catalog exposes exactly one storage; index1 media status3, every other index negative.
Receive catalog reset installs operations table0x013fa838 and selects receive channel1.
Installed device-info and storage-info callbacks are null. Storage count13fa13c, media status13fa154, allocator13fa064. Empty remote datasets must not be replaced with USB identity.
Primary interface count returns1; index1 status3 and every other index negative, identical session/storage behavior to the receive catalog.
Primary interface device-info and storage-info callbacks are also null; count13fbb6c, media13fbb84, allocator13fa064.
Publication distinguishes data versus response by retained operation/response code, not saved eventual response status; data header carries operation and transaction even when dataset is empty.

ownership: RemoteSessionOperations owns saved command-stage response and transaction. Shared PtpState owns the wire session identifier; shared executor owns transport lifecycle and notification publication. These five handlers contain no notification emission.
limits: Primary table0x013fd2ac and receive-catalog table0x013fa838 have identical behavior for these five operations. Arbitrary replacement operation tables are outside this implementation.

The stock storage-list memcpy length includes four bytes beyond the declared list destination; the implementation emits only the declared eight-byte wire dataset and does not reproduce the out-of-bounds copy.
No build, test, formatter, native execution, SDK execution, or live-camera operation was run.
